title: Length of an Encoded Unary Pair
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $w$ be a Boolean word. If $y$ is the self-delimiting encoding of the unary word $1^n$ paired with $w$, then $y$ has length $2n+2+|w|$.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ equals the encoding of $1^n$ paired with $w$
